newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Frances cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Frances cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analysts Jose Garcia-Cantera and Pablo Burbridge have reduced their rating for Argentina's Banco Frances del Rio del la Plata SA to hold from buy.
-- "We believe that Frances' earnings in the first and particularly second quarters of 1997 will be strong, but that the second half will be weaker," they wrote in an April 7 report.
-- "We have lowered our calendar 1997 earnings estimate by eight percent to $1.78 per ADS (American Depositary Share) from $1.94. We maintain our $2.21 1998 estimate."
-- The company's ADSs closed on Monday at 28-3/4.
